name: Optimal Gaussian Splatting
definition: A rendering method that reduces projection error by radially projecting each 3D Gaussian onto a unique tangent plane perpendicular to the line connecting the Gaussian mean to the camera center, rather than projecting all Gaussians onto a single plane z=1.
summary: Optimal Gaussian Splatting reduces projection error by radially projecting 3D Gaussians onto unique tangent planes perpendicular to the camera ray, rather than a fixed plane.
